set.body: Slice of the S5.5 follow-ups (bd-01M3JHHV2FAH6DRBC1KW9JNC51, item 1). A StudyBackend method serving per-record placement and per-trial WindowTally for a spec, drafts included, as a protocol minor (numbered at landing, after 1.9-1.12). The Data panel's SourcePositions/CorrectionLedger.place path is replaced by the served values, and the thumbnail labels point at the tally. No placement is computed in studio.
